description.value: This study investigated TASIT-S social cognition performance and its grey matter correlates in behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia, Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls.

spans.text: Here, we investigated performance on a newly devised short version of The Awareness of Social Inference Test (TASIT-S) and associated neural correlates in 25 bvFTD patients, 23 AD patients and 25 healthy controls.

description.value: The study included 25 bvFTD patients, 23 AD patients and 25 healthy controls; participants completed neuropsychological assessment, TASIT-S and structural MRI.

description.value: A short version of the Awareness of Social Inference Test assessing emotion evaluation and social inference through videotaped vignettes.
